verdict.rationale: Docs confirm context-window limits are enforced (400 error when exceeded) and each model has a dedicated model-card page plus a programmatic /v1/models endpoint, implying some machine-readable size metadata exists, but the evidence pack contains no actual table or per-model input/output token numbers, nor confirmation that output token budgets are separately documented. missing for 10: explicit per-model context-window and max-output-token figures, a single canonical reference table, and independent verification that documented numbers match real usage.
